title: Why you suddenly wake up to one specific sound
hook: You can sleep through anything, except that one sound.

narration.text: Your brain has a silent guardian, a filter for all the noise around you.
It is called the reticular activating system, or RAS.
The RAS acts like a personal alert system, even while you are sleeping.
It decides which sounds are important enough to wake you up.
Think of a parent sleeping through thunder, but waking to a baby's cry.
Your RAS learns what matters to you, even subconsciously.
Which sound always wakes you up, no matter how tired you are?

description: Ever wonder why certain sounds jolt you awake, while others you sleep right through? It is all thanks to your brain's amazing filtering system, the Reticular Activating System. Discover how this part of your brain decides what's important enough to break through your sleep.
topic: Why you might suddenly wake up after hearing a specific sound, explaining the reticular activating system's role in selective attention.
